summary: The diff is a small, spec-faithful implementation of DataView.prototype.getBigUint64. Step 1 (`let view = this;`) and step 2 (`return ? GetViewValue(view, byteOffset, littleEndian, biguint64)`) are each preceded by the spec step comment. The body delegates to the existing `crate::support::typed_array::get_view_value` helper with `ElementType::BigUint64`, so all GetViewValue steps (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex, ToBoolean, out-of-bounds TypeError, RangeError, GetValueFromBuffer) live in that helper, which the diff does not touch. `new_target` is renamed to `_new_target` and the placeholder `let _ = (...)` is removed, which is needed for the new code and is not unrelated. The 2 remaining failures come from the not-implemented throw for BigInt.prototype.valueOf, an honest throw outside this ticket. I did not open the shared helper, so the GetViewValue step ordering there is unverified by this review; the build passing and 40 of 42 tests passing suggest it exists and works.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found in this diff. The only unverified piece is the shared helper `support::typed_array::get_view_value`, which is outside this change. If the two BigInt.prototype.valueOf failures are to be resolved, that belongs to the BigInt ticket, not this one.
